title: Vamana Avatar: Three Steps That Measured the Universe
sources: Bhagavata Purana, Canto 8, chapters 15-23 (Bali conquers the three worlds, Aditi's prayer, Vamana's birth, the sacrifice, the request for three paces, Shukracharya's warning, Trivikrama's two strides, Bali offers his head, Sutala, Vishnu as Bali's doorkeeper)
Vamana Purana and Rig Veda 1.154 (the three strides of Vishnu)

lines.text: Long ago, a demon king named Bali ruled so well that his power spread across all three worlds.
lines.caps: LONG *AGO | A *DEMON KING | NAMED *BALI | RULED SO *WELL | HIS *POWER | SPREAD ACROSS | ALL *THREE WORLDS
lines.say: Long ago, a demon king named Bullee ruled so well that his power spread across all three worlds.

lines.text: Even the gods lost their heaven,
lines.caps: EVEN THE *GODS | LOST THEIR *HEAVEN

lines.text: and their mother Aditi prayed to Vishnu for help.
lines.caps: AND THEIR *MOTHER | *ADITI | PRAYED TO *VISHNU | FOR *HELP
lines.say: and their mother Uh-dee-tee prayed to Vishnu for help.

lines.text: So Vishnu was born as her son, a small and smiling boy named Vamana.
lines.caps: SO *VISHNU | WAS *BORN | AS HER *SON | A *SMALL | AND *SMILING BOY | NAMED *VAMANA
lines.say: So Vishnu was born as her son, a small and smiling boy named Vah-muna.

lines.text: One day, King Bali held a grand ceremony, promising a gift to anyone who asked.
lines.caps: ONE *DAY | KING *BALI | HELD A *GRAND CEREMONY | *PROMISING | A *GIFT | TO *ANYONE | WHO *ASKED
lines.say: One day, King Bullee held a grand ceremony, promising a gift to anyone who asked.

lines.text: Vamana walked in, carrying only a little umbrella and a water pot.
lines.caps: *VAMANA | WALKED *IN | CARRYING *ONLY | A LITTLE *UMBRELLA | AND A *WATER POT
lines.say: Vah-muna walked in, carrying only a little umbrella and a water pot.

lines.text: Bali smiled. Ask for anything, gold, elephants, a whole kingdom.
lines.caps: BALI *SMILED | ASK FOR *ANYTHING | *GOLD | *ELEPHANTS | A WHOLE *KINGDOM
lines.say: Bullee smiled. Ask for anything, gold, elephants, a whole kingdom.

lines.text: But the boy asked only for three steps of land, measured by his own tiny feet.
lines.caps: BUT THE *BOY | ASKED *ONLY | FOR *THREE STEPS | OF *LAND | *MEASURED | BY HIS OWN | *TINY FEET

lines.text: Bali's teacher warned him, this is no ordinary child.
lines.caps: BALI'S *TEACHER | *WARNED HIM | THIS IS NO | *ORDINARY CHILD
lines.say: Bullee's teacher warned him, this is no ordinary child.

lines.text: But Bali had given his word, and he poured the water to seal the gift.
lines.caps: BUT *BALI | HAD GIVEN | HIS *WORD | AND HE *POURED | THE *WATER | TO *SEAL | THE *GIFT
lines.say: But Bullee had given his word, and he poured the water to seal the gift.

lines.text: The moment it touched his hands, Vamana began to grow, past the trees, past the clouds, past the stars.
lines.caps: THE *MOMENT | IT TOUCHED | HIS *HANDS | VAMANA | BEGAN TO *GROW | PAST THE *TREES | PAST THE *CLOUDS | PAST THE *STARS
lines.say: The moment it touched his hands, Vah-muna began to grow, past the trees, past the clouds, past the stars.

lines.text: With his first step, he covered the whole earth.
lines.caps: WITH HIS *FIRST STEP | HE *COVERED | THE WHOLE *EARTH

lines.text: With his second, he covered the heavens and all the stars.
lines.caps: WITH HIS *SECOND | HE COVERED | THE *HEAVENS | AND ALL THE *STARS

lines.text: Then he asked, where shall I place my third?
lines.caps: THEN HE *ASKED | *WHERE | SHALL I *PLACE | MY *THIRD?

lines.text: The universe was his, and nothing was left to give.
lines.caps: THE *UNIVERSE | WAS *HIS | AND *NOTHING | WAS LEFT | TO *GIVE

lines.text: Bali bowed low, and offered his own head.
lines.caps: BALI *BOWED LOW | AND *OFFERED | HIS OWN *HEAD
lines.say: Bullee bowed low, and offered his own head.

lines.text: Moved by his humility, Vishnu blessed him, made him king of the world below,
lines.caps: *MOVED | BY HIS *HUMILITY | VISHNU *BLESSED HIM | MADE HIM *KING | OF THE WORLD *BELOW

lines.text: and promised to guard his door forever.
lines.caps: AND *PROMISED | TO *GUARD | HIS *DOOR | *FOREVER

lines.text: This is Vamana, the fifth avatar of Vishnu,
lines.caps: THIS IS *VAMANA | THE *FIFTH | *AVATAR | OF *VISHNU
lines.say: This is Vah-muna, the fifth avatar of Vishnu,

lines.text: a reminder that true greatness is found in humility, and in keeping your word.
lines.caps: A *REMINDER | TRUE *GREATNESS | IS FOUND IN | *HUMILITY | AND IN *KEEPING | YOUR *WORD
